name: NewterraRes
summary: Newterra Resources Inc. is engaged in the identification and procurement of mineral properties throughout Canada. The company holds an exclusive option to secure full ownership (100%) of the Iron Horse property, an asset comprising nine mineral claims. These claims are situated within British Columbia's Okanagan Valley, spanning the Similkameen and Osoyoos mining divisions. Established in 2021, the firm's primary corporate office is located in Langley, Canada.
